description: Header file defining the gui::file_chooser class, a widget for navigating directories and selecting files in the Wesnoth game project.

classes.name: gui::file_chooser
classes.description: A widget allowing users to navigate directories and select files.

methods.name: file_chooser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the file chooser with a display reference and optional start file.

methods.name: choice_made
methods.description: Checks if the user has completed their file selection.

methods.name: get_choice
methods.description: Returns the filename selected by the user.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Returns the directory of a file or the directory name if input is a directory.

methods.name: get_path_up
methods.description: Returns the path a specified number of levels up.

methods.name: add_path
methods.description: Concatenates a path and a subpath with a delimiter.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if a path is the root of the filesystem.

methods.name: display_current_files
methods.description: Displays files in the current directory.

methods.name: update_file_lists
methods.description: Updates internal lists of files and directories.

methods.name: entry_selected
methods.description: Sets the selected file in the list.

methods.name: entry_chosen
methods.description: Handles directory entry or file selection.

methods.name: get_current_file
methods.description: Retrieves the current filename from selection or textbox.
